description: This file defines the entity class AppUserPreviousPassword which maps to the database table 'm_appuser_previous_password'. It models a previous password record for a user in the application, including fields for user ID, the previous password, and the date the password was removed.

classes.name: AppUserPreviousPassword
classes.description: Entity class representing a user's previous password record, including fields for user ID, password, and removal date, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.
